en.headline: Election Committee nominations reach 756 candidate forms
en.dek: Returning officers received 71 more candidate nomination forms and one from a designated body on Saturday, the fourth day of the two-week nomination window.
body: The Returning Officers for the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections received 71 nomination forms for candidates and one nomination form from a designated body on Saturday, the government said.
This brings the cumulative total to 756 candidate nomination forms and 12 forms from designated bodies since the nomination period opened on 7 October. The period runs until 20 October.

Among the forms received on Saturday, the subsector for representatives of Hong Kong members of relevant national organisations accounted for 34 candidate nominations, the largest single-day total. The subsector for representatives of members of Area Committees, District Fight Crime Committees and District Fire Safety Committees of Hong Kong and Kowloon received nine.
The Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections are scheduled for 22 November. Particulars of the nominations received on Saturday will be uploaded to the election website.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉再接72份提名 累計756份候選人表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任周六接獲71份候選人提名表格及1份指定團體提名表格，提名期第四日，累計候選人提名表格達756份。
body: 政府表示，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的選舉主任周六接獲71份候選人提名表格及1份指定團體提名表格。
自10月7日提名期開始至今，累計接獲756份候選人提名表格及12份指定團體提名表格。提名期將於10月20日結束。
周六接獲的表格中，「有關全國性團體香港成員的代表」界別分組最多，有34份候選人提名；「港九分區委員會、地區撲滅罪行委員會及地區防火委員會委員的代表」則接獲9份。
選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉訂於11月22日舉行。周六接獲的提名詳情將上載至選舉網站。
